subject: Request: Q4 GTM headcount realignment — offer clearance & comp ladder updates
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example>, Finance Ops <finance-ops@redwood-corp.example>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Q4 GTM headcount realignment — offer clearance & comp ladder updates

Team,

Following last week's GTM staffing review, I'm requesting formal approval to reallocate two open SDR headcount slots to higher-impact mid-market AE (quota-carrying) and one Senior Solutions Engineer (SE) for the west region. Summary: 

- Change: 2 x SDR -> 1 x AE (L4) + 1 x Senior SE (L5)
- Rationale: pipeline velocity in mid-market accounts has increased; AE ramp expected to drive $1.2M ARR in year 1 for EMEA/US west accounts. The Senior SE is required for adjacent POCs and to support multi-model integrations for several pilot customers.
- Comp impact: incremental OTE delta vs current SDR plan = +$115k on-target (one-time offer spread across base/commission). See attached Q4-GTM-offer-matrix-v2.pdf and gcs-q4-hc-plan.xlsx for budget impact and payback assumptions.

Action requested:
1) Approve headcount reallocation and updated comp bands for the AE and SE roles (I attached the proposed bands and proposed sign-on allowances).
2) Sign-off on candidate offer templates so TalentOps can extend offers this week (we have two strong candidates: JR-2145 for AE and JR-2170 for SE).

If we don't approve by COB Friday (11/27), we risk losing the AE candidate to a competitor. Candidate details and recommended offers are inside the OfferMatrix PDF.

Attachments: Q4-GTM-offer-matrix-v2.pdf (offer ranges, sign-on recs), gcs-q4-hc-plan.xlsx (budget impact), org-chart-q4.png

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync if needed.

Ben Carter
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.example | +1 415-555-0132

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example>, Finance Ops <finance-ops@redwood-corp.example>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Q4 GTM headcount realignment — offer clearance & comp ladder updates

Ben —

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. I support the rationale in principle but need two clarifications before I can approve:

1) Compensation banding: please call out the proposed base, OTE split, and any signing bonus as an absolute $ amount for each role (not just ranges). The attached matrix had ranges; we need the final numbers for Finance review.
2) Payback timeline: the sheet has a 9‑month payback for the AE — confirm the assumptions (avg deal size, win rate lift, ramp profile).

Once you send that, I can sign off and loop in People Ops for offer letters. If this is urgent (candidate will accept elsewhere), copy the exact offer line items here and I'll provide an expedited approval.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Go-to-Market Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example>, TalentOps <elena@talentbridge.co>, Finance Ops <finance-ops@redwood-corp.example>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Q4 GTM headcount realignment — offer clearance & comp ladder updates

Laura / Ben —

Sending the precise numbers for the two offers below (we've also attached the updated OfferMatrix as a follow-up to include absolute numbers):

Candidate JR-2145 (Mid-Market AE, L4):
- Base: $135,000
- Target OTE: $225,000 (Base + $90k variable)
- Signing bonus: $25,000 (paid over 12 months)
- Equity: 0.18% RSU grant (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff)
- Start target: 12/06/2026
- Notes: Strong pipeline from existing book; comp shown inline with L4 market medians.

Candidate JR-2170 (Senior SE, L5):
- Base: $165,000
- Target OTE: $240,000 (Base + $75k variable)
- Signing bonus: $30,000 (one-time)
- Equity: 0.22% RSU grant (4-year vesting)
- Start target: 12/13/2026
- Notes: Required for enterprise POCs; candidate has deep integrations experience.

Budget impact (annualized run rate) based on these offers: ~$270k incremental comp + $55k one-time signing costs. Detailed math is in gcs-q4-hc-plan.xlsx and the updated OfferMatrix.

Elena (TalentOps), please proceed with conditional offers pending Laura/Vivek sign-off. Finance Ops, if you need a quick headcount charge code, Marissa will follow up with the allocation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Recruiting & Capacity Planning

Ben/Marissa/Laura —

Appreciate the detail. I reviewed the numbers with Finance this morning. I approve the headcount reallocation and the specific offers as outlined for JR-2145 and JR-2170. A couple of notes:

- Please document the funding source (reallocation from SDR budget) in the HR system so monthly reporting maps correctly.
- Cap the total sign-on spend for Q4 at $60k (we're proposing $55k total but want the explicit cap).

With that, TalentOps can move forward and extend offers. Laura — if you want to be looped into the offer call for JR-2145, let me know and Ben can set it up.
